title: WIPEOUTVARIABLES DXF class-version field
scope: Model and transport the WIPEOUTVARIABLES DXF class-version field without widening DWG-origin owner-graph admission. Tolerant input retains unsupported class versions; typed output admits only the documented zero value.

implementation.behavior: DRW_WipeoutVariables exposes and resets m_classVersion; parseCode reads group 90 as a 32-bit value; writeWipeoutVariables emits group 90 before group 70 and rejects nonzero class versions or invalid display-frame values before table-entry identity reservation. The DWG codec remains unchanged because group 90 is a DXF field.

regressionControl.coverage: ASCII and Binary output both emit and read back group 90=0. Nonzero class version and frame=2 are refused without bytes, corrected on the same writer, and read back with one identity. A tolerant ASCII input with group 90=1 retains that value and the exact raw group for caller inspection.
